_comment: Pre-migration state with python-expert.md at the v0 path. Migration 001 moves it under domain-experts/, then migration 002 deletes domain-experts/ entirely. Migrations 003/004 (remove-roadmap, remove-hire) find nothing to act on in this before/ tree — it never had .awos/commands/roadmap.md, .awos/templates/roadmap-template.md, .awos/commands/hire.md, or .awos/templates/agent-template.md — so their operations are no-ops here. Final state: the old path is empty, the migrated subdirectory is gone. The migration-version file's exact numeric content is asserted dynamically by tests/installer/migration-runner.test.js (it reflects the highest migration version processed, not just the ones whose preconditions matched this tree) — only its existence is pinned here.
